description: Capability tiers available on Defici, described by what each tier unlocks — not by price (pricing is not finalized yet, so no price figure is returned by this tool). Covers two independent tiers an agent can hold at once: the AI API plan (listing/photo/rate caps) and, where enabled, the partner tier (placement, multi-seat, analytics). Only capabilities that are live today are listed here.
name: get_subscription_info
